# vla-mcp full index

## Purpose

Orchestrate X Square open-weight VLA stack with local MCP fleet (worldlabs-mcp, robotics-mcp, avatarops) for event-grounded synthetic training.

## MCP tools

### vla_status
Read-only snapshot of Wall-OSS, WALL-WM, DMuon upstream paths and dataset episode count.

### vla_wall
Operations: health, infer_prepare, finetune_prepare, list_tasks.
Wall-OSS-0.5 uses flow-matching action supervision for zero-shot manipulation.

### vla_world_model
Operations: health, train_prepare, predict_prepare, event_vocab.
WALL-WM couples Wan text-to-video prior with action DiT; segments: approaching, contact, lift, slide, recovery.

### vla_dataset
Operations: ingest_episode, list_episodes (paginated), export_shard, validate_multiview.
Stores JSON episodes under VLA_DATASET_ROOT.

### vla_training
Operations: health, co_train_prepare, config_template.
DMuon distributed Muon optimizer for gradient-bridged co-training.

### vla_fleet
Operations: bridge_status, scenario_brief, list_peers.
Default peers: worldlabs :10865, robotics :10892, avatar :10793.

### vla_agentic_workflow
SEP-1577 multi-step planning with optional ctx.sample.

## Environment

VLA_WALL_X_ROOT, VLA_WALL_WM_ROOT, VLA_DMUON_ROOT, VLA_CHECKPOINT, VLA_DATASET_ROOT, VLA_DEVICE, VLA_*_MCP_URL

## Run

uv sync --extra dev
uv run pytest tests -q
uv run uvicorn vla_mcp.server:app --port 11024
